allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

fixtures.description: Array of test fixtures providing concrete input/expected pairs for validating spec artifacts.

items.description: A single test fixture with input data, expected output, testing mode, and target references.

fixture_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this fixture (e.g., 'fix-login-success').

description.description: Human-readable description of what this fixture tests.

targets.description: Array of trace references to the spec artifacts this fixture validates (FRs, APIs, invariants, NFRs).

items.description: A trace reference to a spec artifact this fixture validates.

mode.description: Testing mode: unit (isolated), contract (API boundary), e2e (end-to-end flow), or redteam (adversarial).

input.description: Input data for this test fixture, can be any valid JSON value.

expected.description: Expected output or result for this test fixture, can be any valid JSON value.

tags.description: Classification tags for organizing and filtering fixtures.

items.description: A classification tag for this fixture.

tag_ref.description: Canonical reference linking fixture tags to the canonical registry.
